description: This Java interface defines a repository for managing ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer entities, including various query methods for retrieving transfers based on different criteria such as loan ID, external ID, and effective dates. It uses Spring Data JPA for data access operations.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer entities, extending JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide CRUD and specification-based querying capabilities.

methods.name: findAllByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of transfers associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: findAllByExternalLoanId
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of transfers associated with a specific external loan ID.

methods.name: findAllByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of transfers associated with a specific external ID.

methods.name: findLatestByLoanId
methods.description: Find the most recent transfer for a given loan ID.

methods.name: findActiveByLoanId
methods.description: Find the active transfer linked to a specific loan ID via a join fetch.

methods.name: findActiveOwnerByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieve the current owner (ExternalAssetOwner) associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: findEffectiveTransfersOrderByIdDesc
methods.description: Get a list of effective transfers for a loan after a certain date, ordered by ID descending.

methods.name: findFirstByExternalIdOrderByIdAsc
methods.description: Retrieve the earliest transfer record based on external ID.

methods.name: findLastByExternalIdOrderByIdDesc
methods.description: Get the maximum ID for a transfer with a specific external ID.

calls: select e from ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer e where e.loanId = :loanId and e.id = (select max(ex.id) from ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer ex where ex.loanId = :loanId)
select m.ownerTransfer from ExternalAssetOwnerTransferLoanMapping m where m.loanId = :loanId
select m.ownerTransfer.owner from ExternalAssetOwnerTransferLoanMapping m where m.loanId = :loanId
SELECT t FROM ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer t WHERE t.loanId = :loanId AND t.effectiveDateTo > :effectiveDate order by t.id desc
select max(e.id) from ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer e where e.externalId = :externalTransferId
